Pinned versions

The versions of the runtime and its dependencies that are pinned to keep things reproducible. How to install and build the app is in INSTALL.md.

ItemPinned version / revision
PlatformsmacOS (Apple silicon, macOS 26 or later; checked on macOS 27.2, M3 Max), Linux (x86_64 and aarch64, needs Nix; checked in an OrbStack VM (Ubuntu 26.04, aarch64), on a friend's Ubuntu (x86_64) and on NixOS (x86_64, over SSH)), Windows (needs WSL2 and Nix; verified in WSL2, with Nix without its daemon)
Node.js (bundled with the Mac's tsugumi command)cli/node-version.env (the official build, checked by checksum). On Linux and Windows, the pinned nixpkgs' nodejs
Shared VMLinux kernel 6.12.115 (macOS/Container/kernel.nix; SELinux and io_uring disabled, unprivileged BPF off) + a read-only rootfs (erofs, macOS/Container/vm-boot.nix; a boot disk with only Nix from nixpkgs, published at gen740/tsugumi-vm). Tsugumi itself is built inside the VM from the nixpkgs of the same flake.lock (macOS/Container/vm-system.nix)
Builder for the VM imagedocker.io/nixos/nix:2.31.2 running on Apple container 0.6.0 (only for building the boot disk during development; not used when the app runs)
nixpkgs1c89083e451e891152365b799595cf7790a43325 (flake.lock; the Cards' default tsugumi:default is the same revision)
FlatBuffers25.12.19 (C++ / Python from nixpkgs; Swift pinned to the same version with SwiftPM)
hosq (C++ JSON)CLI20-dev/hosq@1eb8942 (a flake input)
Dawn (WebGPU)v20261023.194543 (ui/renderer/CMakeLists.txt, Metal backend)
SwiftTerm (terminal display, MIT)1.11.2 (pinned because later versions need Xcode's Metal Toolchain to be fetched separately to compile shaders)
Swift Markdown / SwiftMath (Markdown and maths in the chat, sticky notes and Cards)0.7.3 / 1.7.3 (macOS/Package.swift)
SwiftTreeSitter and the language grammars (syntax highlighting in the editor)SwiftTreeSitter 0.25.0; each grammar at its own version (macOS/Package.swift)
xterm.js / addon-fit / node-pty (the Web UI's terminal, MIT)5.5.0 / 0.10.0 / 1.1.0 (web/package-lock.json)
libgit2 (versions)1.9.7 (the pinned nixpkgs' libgit2)
plotly.js / Vega / Vega-Lite / Vega-Embed (display of Card charts)3.6.0 / 6.4.0 / 6.4.3 / 7.3.0 (web/package-lock.json; the Mac app copies the same files in build-app.sh)
